"""Application configuration."""
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings

SERVICE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def _resolve_path(value: str) -> str:
    path = Path(value)
    return str(path if path.is_absolute() else (SERVICE_ROOT / path).resolve())


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    APP_NAME: str = "AI Diagnosis Service"
    DEBUG: bool = False
    PORT: int = 8000

    # Model artefacts
    MODEL_PATH: str = "./models/diagnosis_model.pkl"
    DISEASES_PATH: str = "./models/diseases_fixed.json"
    SYMPTOMS_PATH: str = "./models/symptoms_fixed.json"

    # Diagnosis parameters
    DEFAULT_TOP_K: int = 10
    MIN_PROBABILITY: float = 0.01     # filter out diseases below this
    ML_WEIGHT: float = 0.7            # weight of ML score in final combined score
    RULE_WEIGHT: float = 0.3          # weight of rule-based score

    # Internal API Security
    INTERNAL_API_KEY: str = "internal-secret-key-12345"

    def model_post_init(self, __context) -> None:
        self.MODEL_PATH = _resolve_path(self.MODEL_PATH)
        self.DISEASES_PATH = _resolve_path(self.DISEASES_PATH)
        self.SYMPTOMS_PATH = _resolve_path(self.SYMPTOMS_PATH)

    class Config:
        env_file = ".env"
        env_file_encoding = "utf-8"
        extra = "ignore"


@lru_cache()
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    return Settings()


settings = get_settings()

"""Internal API key dependency — the ONLY auth on this service."""
import hmac
import logging
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import Request

from app.config import settings
from app.exceptions import InternalAPIKeyError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def verify_internal_api_key(
    request: Request,
    x_internal_api_key: Optional[str] = None,
) -> bool:
    if x_internal_api_key is None:
        x_internal_api_key = request.headers.get("X-Internal-API-Key")

    provided = (x_internal_api_key or "").encode("utf-8")
    expected = settings.INTERNAL_API_KEY.encode("utf-8")

    if not provided or not hmac.compare_digest(provided, expected):
        logger.warning(
            "Rejected request to %s %s: missing or invalid internal API key",
            request.method,
            request.url.path,
        )
        raise InternalAPIKeyError()

    return True

"""Custom exceptions."""
from fastapi import HTTPException, status


class InternalAPIKeyError(HTTPException):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Invalid or missing internal API key",
        )


class ModelNotLoadedError(HTTPException):
    def __init__(self, detail: str = "Diagnosis model is not loaded"):
        super().__init__(
            status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
            detail=detail,
        )


class DiagnosisError(HTTPException):
    def __init__(self, detail: str = "Diagnosis failed"):
        super().__init__(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail=detail,
        )

"""FastAPI application factory for AI Diagnosis Service."""
import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from starlette.concurrency import run_in_threadpool

from app.config import settings
from app.routers import diagnosis, health
from app.services.model_service import diagnosis_model
from app.services.rule_engine import disease_registry

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.DEBUG if settings.DEBUG else logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s | %(levelname)s | %(name)s | %(message)s",
)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    logger.info("%s starting up...", settings.APP_NAME)
    logger.info("  model path:      %s", settings.MODEL_PATH)
    logger.info("  diseases path:   %s", settings.DISEASES_PATH)
    # Loading the model and registry is blocking — keep it off the event loop
    await run_in_threadpool(diagnosis_model.load)
    await run_in_threadpool(disease_registry.load)
    if diagnosis_model.loaded and disease_registry.loaded:
        logger.info(
            "Model ready — %d disease classes, %d diseases in registry",
            diagnosis_model.classes_count,
            disease_registry.count,
        )
    else:
        logger.error(
            "Service started in degraded mode: model=%s registry=%s",
            diagnosis_model.loaded,
            disease_registry.loaded,
        )
    yield
    logger.info("%s shutting down...", settings.APP_NAME)
    diagnosis_model.unload()


def create_application() -> FastAPI:
    app = FastAPI(
        title=settings.APP_NAME,
        description="""
        Healthcare AI - AI Diagnosis Service (INTERNAL)

        Predicts probable diseases from a list of evidence IDs (symptoms).

        Uses a hybrid scoring system:
          - ML model: LogisticRegression trained on 457 diseases × 1243 features
          - Rule engine: weight matching against diseases_fixed.json

        NOT exposed through the API Gateway. Every endpoint except /health
        requires X-Internal-API-Key.

        Endpoints:
          POST /diagnose     — evidence_ids → disease predictions
          GET  /health       — service + model health
          GET  /model-info   — model metadata
        """,
        version="1.0.0",
        lifespan=lifespan,
        docs_url="/docs",
        redoc_url="/redoc",
        redirect_slashes=False,
    )

    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=["*"],
        allow_credentials=True,
        allow_methods=["*"],
        allow_headers=["*"],
    )

    app.include_router(health.router)
    app.include_router(diagnosis.router)

    @app.exception_handler(Exception)
    async def global_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception):
        logger.exception("Unhandled error on %s %s", request.method, request.url.path)
        return JSONResponse(status_code=500, content={"detail": "Internal server error"})

    @app.get("/", tags=["Root"])
    async def root():
        return {
            "service": settings.APP_NAME,
            "version": "1.0.0",
            "type": "internal",
            "docs": "/docs",
        }

    return app


app = create_application()

[10/214] ai-diagnosis-service/app/routers/diagnosis.py

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
"""Diagnosis endpoint — the core of ai-diagnosis-service.

POST /diagnose
  Input:  {evidence_ids: [...], patient_sex: "M"|"F", patient_age?: int, top_k?: int}
  Output: {predictions: [{disease_id, disease_name_fa, icd10, ml_probability,
                          rule_score, combined_score, matched_evidences, ...}], ...}

The service combines two scoring systems:
  1. ML model (LogisticRegression) — gives ml_probability for each of 457 diseases
  2. Rule engine (diseases_fixed.json) — gives rule_score based on symptom weight matching

Final combined_score = ML_WEIGHT * ml_probability + RULE_WEIGHT * rule_score
"""
import logging
import time
from typing import List

import numpy as np
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends

from app.config import settings
from app.dependencies.auth import verify_internal_api_key
from app.exceptions import DiagnosisError, ModelNotLoadedError
from app.schemas.diagnosis import (
    DiagnosisRequest,
    DiagnosisResponse,
    DiseasePrediction,
    MatchedEvidence,
)
from app.services.model_service import diagnosis_model
from app.services.rule_engine import disease_registry

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(tags=["Diagnosis"], dependencies=[Depends(verify_internal_api_key)])


@router.post("/diagnose", response_model=DiagnosisResponse)
async def diagnose(data: DiagnosisRequest) -> DiagnosisResponse:
    """Predict probable diseases from a list of evidence IDs.

    Called by ai-triage-service (or visit-intake-service) when the doctor
    claims a visit. The evidence_ids come from ParsBERT's extraction on the
    patient's free text.

    Auth: requires X-Internal-API-Key header.
    """
    if not diagnosis_model.loaded:
        raise ModelNotLoadedError(
            f"Diagnosis model is not loaded: {diagnosis_model.load_error}"
        )
    if not disease_registry.loaded:
        raise ModelNotLoadedError(
            f"Disease registry is not loaded: {disease_registry.load_error}"
        )

    if not data.evidence_ids:
        raise DiagnosisError("At least one evidence_id is required")

    started = time.perf_counter()
    patient_sex = (data.patient_sex or "M").upper()
    present_set = set(data.evidence_ids)

    logger.info(
        "Diagnosis request: %d evidences, sex=%s, age=%s, top_k=%d",
        len(data.evidence_ids),
        patient_sex,
        data.patient_age,
        data.top_k,
    )

    # ── 1. ML model prediction ──
    probabilities, ml_time_ms = diagnosis_model.predict(
        evidence_ids=data.evidence_ids,
        patient_sex=patient_sex,
    )

    # ── 2. Rule-based scoring + combination ──
    predictions: List[DiseasePrediction] = []

    for i, disease_id in enumerate(diagnosis_model.classes):
        ml_prob = float(probabilities[i])

        # Skip diseases with very low ML probability (perf optimization)
        if ml_prob < settings.MIN_PROBABILITY:
            continue

        # Rule-based score
        rule_score, matched, absent = disease_registry.compute_rule_score(
            disease_id=disease_id,
            present_evidences=present_set,
        )

        # Combined score
        combined = (
            settings.ML_WEIGHT * ml_prob
            + settings.RULE_WEIGHT * rule_score
        )

        # Skip if combined score is also very low
        if combined < settings.MIN_PROBABILITY:
            continue

        info = disease_registry.get_disease_info(disease_id)

        matched_evs = [
            MatchedEvidence(
                evidence_id=m["evidence_id"],
                weight=m["weight"],
                evidence_class=m["evidence_class"],
                name_fa=m.get("name_fa"),
            )
            for m in matched[:10]  # cap at 10 matched evidences for response size
        ]
        absent_evs = [
            MatchedEvidence(
                evidence_id=a["evidence_id"],
                weight=a["weight"],
                evidence_class=a["evidence_class"],
                name_fa=a.get("name_fa"),
            )
            for a in absent[:5]
        ]

        predictions.append(DiseasePrediction(
            disease_id=disease_id,
            disease_name_fa=info["disease_name_fa"],
            disease_name_en=info["disease_name_en"],
            icd10=info["icd10"],
            ml_probability=round(ml_prob, 4),
            rule_score=round(rule_score, 4),
            combined_score=round(combined, 4),
            is_emergency=info["is_emergency"],
            severity=info["severity"],
            matched_evidences=matched_evs,
            absent_evidences=absent_evs,
        ))

    # ── 3. Sort by combined score and take top_k ──
    predictions.sort(key=lambda p: p.combined_score, reverse=True)
    predictions = predictions[:data.top_k]

    total_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
    logger.info(
        "Diagnosis complete: %d predictions (from %d classes), %.1f ms total (ML: %.1f ms)",
        len(predictions),
        len(diagnosis_model.classes),
        total_ms,
        ml_time_ms,
    )

    return DiagnosisResponse(
        predictions=predictions,
        input_evidence_count=len(data.evidence_ids),
        patient_sex=patient_sex,
        model_version="logistic-regression-v1",
        inference_time_ms=round(total_ms, 1),
        rule_engine_version="rule-based-v1",
    )

"""Health endpoint — no auth required."""
import logging

from fastapi import APIRouter, Response

from app.schemas.diagnosis import ModelInfo
from app.services.model_service import diagnosis_model
from app.services.rule_engine import disease_registry

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(tags=["Health"])


@router.get("/health")
async def health(response: Response) -> dict:
    """200 when the service is up. Model status is reported but doesn't affect HTTP code."""
    model_ok = diagnosis_model.loaded
    registry_ok = disease_registry.loaded

    status_str = "healthy" if (model_ok and registry_ok) else "degraded"

    return {
        "status": status_str,
        "model_loaded": model_ok,
        "disease_registry_loaded": registry_ok,
        "model_error": diagnosis_model.load_error if not model_ok else None,
        "registry_error": disease_registry.load_error if not registry_ok else None,
    }


@router.get("/model-info", response_model=ModelInfo)
async def model_info() -> ModelInfo:
    """Operator-facing model metadata."""
    return ModelInfo(
        model_type="LogisticRegression + DictVectorizer",
        model_path=settings.MODEL_PATH,
        diseases_path=settings.DISEASES_PATH,
        classes_count=diagnosis_model.classes_count,
        features_count=diagnosis_model.features_count,
        disease_registry_count=disease_registry.count,
        loaded_at=diagnosis_model.loaded_at,
    )

"""Diagnosis request/response schemas."""
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


class DiagnosisRequest(BaseModel):
    """POST /diagnose request body.

    evidence_ids: list of evidence codes detected by ai-nlp-service (ParsBERT)
    patient_sex:  "M" or "F" — the ML model uses this as its 1243rd feature
    patient_age:  optional age in years — used for rule-based age filtering
    top_k:        how many top diseases to return (default 10)
    """

    evidence_ids: List[str] = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=1,
        description="Evidence codes from ai-nlp-service, e.g. ['E_00_0001', 'E_06_0004']",
    )
    patient_sex: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None,
        pattern="^(M|F|m|f)$",
        description="Patient sex: M or F. Defaults to M if not provided.",
    )
    patient_age: Optional[int] = Field(
        default=None,
        ge=0,
        le=150,
        description="Patient age in years — used for rule-based age filtering",
    )
    top_k: int = Field(default=10, ge=1, le=50)


class MatchedEvidence(BaseModel):
    """One evidence that contributed to a disease's rule-based score."""

    evidence_id: str
    weight: float
    evidence_class: str   # cardinal | major | minor
    name_fa: Optional[str] = None


class DiseasePrediction(BaseModel):
    """One predicted disease with probability and metadata."""

    disease_id: str                              # e.g. "D_04_0010"
    disease_name_fa: str                         # e.g. "تانسیلیت"
    disease_name_en: str                         # e.g. "Tonsillitis"
    icd10: Optional[str] = None                  # e.g. "J03.9"
    ml_probability: float                        # raw ML model probability (0-1)
    rule_score: float                            # rule-based score (0-1)
    combined_score: float                        # weighted combination
    is_emergency: bool = False
    severity: int = 1                            # 1-5
    matched_evidences: List[MatchedEvidence] = []
    absent_evidences: List[MatchedEvidence] = []  # evidences that should be absent


class DiagnosisResponse(BaseModel):
    """POST /diagnose response."""

    predictions: List[DiseasePrediction]
    input_evidence_count: int
    patient_sex: str
    model_version: str
    inference_time_ms: float
    rule_engine_version: str


class ModelInfo(BaseModel):
    """GET /model-info response."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="ignore")

    model_type: str
    model_path: str
    diseases_path: str
    classes_count: int
    features_count: int
    disease_registry_count: int
    loaded_at: Optional[str] = None

"""ML model loader and predictor — wraps the LogisticRegression + DictVectorizer bundle.

The PKL file is a dict with three keys:
  - 'model':      LogisticRegression (457 classes, 1243 features)
  - 'vectorizer': DictVectorizer (1242 evidence features)
  - 'classes':    ndarray of disease IDs (457)

The 1243rd feature (not in the vectorizer) is SEX:
  - 1 = Male
  - 0 = Female

Evidence features in the vectorizer follow this pattern:
  - Boolean evidences (data_type B): just the evidence_id, e.g. "E_00_0001"
  - Multi-value evidences (data_type M/C): "E_XX_XXXX_@_V_YYY", one per possible value
    e.g. "E_00_0002_@_V_100" means pain_location = forehead

For v1, we only set boolean features (since ParsBERT gives us boolean present/absent).
Multi-value features require the patient's specific answer, which isn't available yet.
"""
import logging
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

import joblib
import numpy as np
from scipy import sparse

from app.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class DiagnosisModel:
    """Singleton wrapper around the trained LogisticRegression model."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.model = None          # LogisticRegression
        self.vectorizer = None     # DictVectorizer
        self.classes = None        # ndarray of disease IDs
        self.feature_names: List[str] = []
        self.loaded: bool = False
        self.load_error: Optional[str] = None
        self.loaded_at: Optional[str] = None

    @property
    def classes_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.classes) if self.classes is not None else 0

    @property
    def features_count(self) -> int:
        return self.model.n_features_in_ if self.model is not None else 0

    def load(self) -> None:
        """Load the model bundle from disk. Never raises — stays alive in degraded mode."""
        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            logger.info("Loading diagnosis model from %s", settings.MODEL_PATH)
            bundle = joblib.load(settings.MODEL_PATH)

            if not isinstance(bundle, dict):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Expected a dict bundle with 'model', 'vectorizer', 'classes' keys, "
                    f"got {type(bundle).__name__}"
                )

            self.model = bundle["model"]
            self.vectorizer = bundle["vectorizer"]
            self.classes = bundle["classes"]
            self.feature_names = list(self.vectorizer.feature_names_)

            self.loaded = True
            self.load_error = None
            self.loaded_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
            elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
            logger.info(
                "Diagnosis model loaded in %.1f ms — %d classes, %d features (%d from vectorizer + 1 sex)",
                elapsed_ms,
                len(self.classes),
                self.model.n_features_in_,
                len(self.feature_names),
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.loaded = False
            self.load_error = str(exc) or exc.__class__.__name__
            self.model = None
            self.vectorizer = None
            logger.error("Diagnosis model failed to load: %s", self.load_error, exc_info=True)

    def unload(self) -> None:
        self.loaded = False
        self.model = None
        self.vectorizer = None
        self.classes = None

    def _build_feature_dict(
        self,
        evidence_ids: List[str],
        patient_sex: str,
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """Convert evidence_ids + sex into a feature dict for the DictVectorizer.

        - Boolean evidence_ids are set to 1.0
        - Multi-value evidence_ids (E_XX_XXXX) that have sub-features (E_XX_XXXX_@_V_YYY)
          are skipped for now — we'd need the specific value to set the right sub-feature
        - Sex is NOT in the dict — it's added as a separate column after vectorization
        """
        feature_set = set(self.feature_names)
        feature_dict: Dict[str, float] = {}

        for eid in evidence_ids:
            # Direct boolean feature
            if eid in feature_set:
                feature_dict[eid] = 1.0
            else:
                # Check if this evidence has multi-value sub-features
                prefix = f"{eid}_@_"
                sub_features = [f for f in self.feature_names if f.startswith(prefix)]
                if sub_features:
                    # For v1, skip multi-value evidences — we'd need the patient's answer
                    # to know which V_YYY to set. ParsBERT only gives us boolean presence.
                    logger.debug(
                        "Evidence %s has %d sub-features but no value provided — skipping",
                        eid,
                        len(sub_features),
                    )
                else:
                    logger.debug("Evidence %s not found in model features — skipping", eid)

        return feature_dict

    def predict(
        self,
        evidence_ids: List[str],
        patient_sex: str = "M",
    ) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, float]:
        """Run inference and return (probabilities, elapsed_ms).

        Returns a 1-D array of probabilities aligned with self.classes.
        """
        if not self.loaded or self.model is None or self.vectorizer is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Model not loaded")

        started = time.perf_counter()

        # 1. Build feature dict from evidence_ids
        feature_dict = self._build_feature_dict(evidence_ids, patient_sex)
        logger.info(
            "Feature dict: %d evidence_ids → %d features set",
            len(evidence_ids),
            len(feature_dict),
        )

        if not feature_dict:
            logger.warning("No matching features found for evidence_ids: %s", evidence_ids)
            # Return uniform probabilities
            n_classes = len(self.classes)
            return np.full(n_classes, 1.0 / n_classes), (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000

        # 2. Vectorize
        X_vec = self.vectorizer.transform(feature_dict)  # sparse matrix (1, 1242)

        # 3. Add sex feature (1243rd column)
        #    1 = Male, 0 = Female
        sex_val = 1.0 if patient_sex.upper() == "M" else 0.0
        sex_col = sparse.csr_matrix(np.array([[sex_val]]))
        X_full = sparse.hstack([X_vec, sex_col], format="csr")  # (1, 1243)

        # 4. Predict probabilities
        probabilities = self.model.predict_proba(X_full)[0]  # shape: (457,)

        elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
        logger.info(
            "Diagnosis inference: %d classes, %.1f ms",
            len(probabilities),
            elapsed_ms,
        )

        return probabilities, elapsed_ms


# Module-level singleton
diagnosis_model = DiagnosisModel()

"""Rule-based scoring engine using diseases_fixed.json.

For each disease in the registry, we compute a rule-based score based on:
  1. symptoms (weights): sum of weights for evidence_ids that match
  2. absence_symptoms: penalty for evidence_ids that SHOULD be absent but ARE present

The score is normalized to [0, 1] by dividing by the max possible weight (sum of all
symptom weights for that disease).
"""
import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple

from app.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class DiseaseRegistry:
    """Loads and indexes diseases_fixed.json for fast lookup."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.diseases: Dict[str, dict] = {}   # disease_id → full record
        self.loaded: bool = False
        self.load_error: Optional[str] = None

    @property
    def count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.diseases)

    def load(self) -> None:
        """Load diseases_fixed.json from disk."""
        try:
            path = Path(settings.DISEASES_PATH)
            if not path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Diseases file not found: {path}")

            with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                raw = json.load(f)

            if not isinstance(raw, dict) or not raw:
                raise ValueError(f"Diseases file must be a non-empty JSON object: {path}")

            self.diseases = {str(k): v for k, v in raw.items()}
            self.loaded = True
            self.load_error = None
            logger.info("Loaded %d diseases from %s", len(self.diseases), path)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.loaded = False
            self.load_error = str(exc) or exc.__class__.__name__
            self.diseases = {}
            logger.error("Disease registry failed to load: %s", self.load_error, exc_info=True)

    def get_disease(self, disease_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        return self.diseases.get(disease_id)

    def compute_rule_score(
        self,
        disease_id: str,
        present_evidences: Set[str],
    ) -> Tuple[float, List[dict], List[dict]]:
        """Compute a rule-based score for a disease given the present evidences.

        Returns:
            (score, matched_evidences, absent_evidences)
            - score: float in [0, 1]
            - matched_evidences: list of {evidence_id, weight, class, name_fa}
            - absent_evidences: list of evidences that SHOULD be absent but ARE present
        """
        disease = self.diseases.get(disease_id)
        if not disease:
            return 0.0, [], []

        # ── 1. Positive scoring from symptoms ──
        symptoms = disease.get("symptoms", {})
        max_possible_weight = sum(s.get("weight", 0) for s in symptoms.values())
        if max_possible_weight == 0:
            return 0.0, [], []

        matched: List[dict] = []
        matched_weight = 0.0

        for eid, info in symptoms.items():
            weight = info.get("weight", 0)
            evidence_class = info.get("class", "minor")
            if eid in present_evidences:
                matched_weight += weight
                matched.append({
                    "evidence_id": eid,
                    "weight": weight,
                    "evidence_class": evidence_class,
                    "name_fa": info.get("name_fa"),
                })

        positive_score = matched_weight / max_possible_weight

        # ── 2. Penalty from absence_symptoms ──
        # If an evidence that SHOULD be absent IS present, reduce the score
        absence = disease.get("absence_symptoms", {})
        absent_violations: List[dict] = []
        penalty = 0.0

        for eid, info in absence.items():
            weight = info.get("weight", 0)
            if eid in present_evidences:
                # This evidence is present but shouldn't be → penalty
                penalty += weight * 0.5   # 50% penalty (not full, since it's a soft signal)
                absent_violations.append({
                    "evidence_id": eid,
                    "weight": weight,
                    "evidence_class": info.get("class", "minor"),
                    "name_fa": info.get("note", ""),
                })

        # Normalize penalty relative to max possible weight
        if max_possible_weight > 0:
            penalty = min(penalty / max_possible_weight, 0.5)   # cap at 50% reduction

        final_score = max(0.0, positive_score - penalty)
        return final_score, matched, absent_violations

    def get_disease_info(self, disease_id: str) -> dict:
        """Extract display info for a disease."""
        d = self.diseases.get(disease_id, {})
        return {
            "disease_id": disease_id,
            "disease_name_fa": d.get("name_fa", disease_id),
            "disease_name_en": d.get("name_en", disease_id),
            "icd10": d.get("icd10"),
            "is_emergency": d.get("is_emergency", False),
            "severity": d.get("severity", 1),
            "category": d.get("category"),
            "red_flags": d.get("red_flags", []),
            "differential": d.get("differential", []),
        }


# Module-level singleton
disease_registry = DiseaseRegistry()

# ai-nlp-service

Stateless inference microservice for the healthcare-ai platform. It loads the
trained **ParsBERT Evidence Classifier** once at startup and serves exactly one
job:

> Persian free text in -> list of detected evidence codes with confidence scores out.

It performs **no orchestration**: it does not call visit-intake-service, it
does not call triage, it stores nothing anywhere. The visit-intake-service
calls `POST /extract`, then calls triage separately, then pushes the results
to its own database. This service is internal-only and is never routed through
the API gateway (see [Patches](#patches-to-existing-services)).

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/extract` | `X-Internal-API-Key` (skipped when `DEV_MODE=true`) | Persian text -> evidence codes + confidences |
| GET | `/health` | public | `200` when the model is loaded, `503` otherwise |
| GET | `/model-info` | `X-Internal-API-Key` | checkpoint / evidence metadata |

## Project layout

```
services/ai-nlp-service/
├── app/
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── main.py                   # create_application() factory + lifespan
│   ├── config.py                 # pydantic_settings, @lru_cache get_settings()
│   ├── exceptions.py             # InternalAPIKeyError, ModelNotLoadedError
│   ├── dependencies/
│   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   └── auth.py               # verify_internal_api_key (X-Internal-API-Key)
│   ├── schemas/
│   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   └── nlp.py                # ExtractRequest, DetectedEvidence, ExtractResponse, ...
│   ├── services/
│   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   ├── evidence_loader.py    # load_evidences(path) -> (eid_list, eid_info)
│   │   ├── classifier.py         # EvidenceClassifier (verbatim training-time class)
│   │   └── nlp_service.py        # NLPService singleton + post-processing
│   └── routers/
│       ├── __init__.py
│       ├── extract.py            # POST /extract, GET /model-info
│       └── health.py             # GET /health
├── models/

├── tests/
```

## Run locally

```bash
cd services/ai-nlp-service

python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate   # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate

# CPU-only torch is far smaller than the default CUDA wheel:
pip install torch==2.5.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Optional: DEV_MODE=true lets you curl without the internal API key
cp .env.example .env

# Point the paths at your artefacts (or copy them into ./models/)
uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8005 --reload
```

Notes:

- The first startup downloads the ParsBERT base weights + tokenizer from the
  HuggingFace hub (`HooshvareLab/bert-fa-base-uncased`); the fine-tuned
  checkpoint is loaded from disk afterwards. See [Decisions](#decisions) #12.
- If the checkpoint or evidence file is missing/corrupt, or the checkpoint's
  class count does not match the evidence list, the service **stays alive**
  but reports `503` on `/health` — it never crashes on a bad artefact.

## Run tests

```bash
pytest tests -v
```

Tests never touch torch, the checkpoint or the HuggingFace hub: the
`NLPService` singleton is replaced by `FakeNLPService` (see
`tests/conftest.py`), which reuses the real post-processing logic.

## Docker

```bash
# from the repo root
docker compose build ai-nlp-service
docker compose up -d ai-nlp-service

curl http://localhost:8005/health
```

The image is multi-stage. `TORCH_VARIANT` selects the torch wheel index
(default `cpu`; use `cu121` for CUDA 12.1):

```bash
docker compose build --build-arg TORCH_VARIANT=cu121 ai-nlp-service
```

`best_model.pt` (~600 MB) and `evidence_list_clean.json` must exist in
`services/ai-nlp-service/models/` before the build — the build fails with
`missing best_model.pt` / `missing evidence_list_clean.json` otherwise.

## Example requests

`POST /extract` (via the compose host mapping `8005:8000`):

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8005/extract \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Internal-API-Key: internal-secret-key-12345" \
  -d '{
        "text": "سلام پوستم قرمز شده. سرم درد میکنه تب هم دارم",
        "threshold": 0.3,
        "top_k": null,
        "apply_hierarchy_filter": true
      }'
```

Example response:

```json
{
  "text": "سلام پوستم قرمز شده. سرم درد میکنه تب هم دارم",
  "detected": [
    {
      "evidence_id": "E_19_0001",
      "name": "skin_lesions",
      "name_fa": "ضایعات پوستی",
      "question_en": "Do you have any lesions, redness or problems on your skin...",
      "question_fa": "آیا ضایعه، قرمزی یا مشکل پوستی مرتبط با علت مراجعه دارید؟",
      "data_type": "B",
      "is_antecedent": false,
      "code_question": "E_19_0001",
      "default_value": 0,
      "value_meaning": {},
      "possible-values": [],
      "confidence": 0.8734
    },
    { "evidence_id": "E_19_0002", "name": "lesion_color", "confidence": 0.5121, "..." : "..." }
  ],
  "threshold": 0.3,
  "apply_hierarchy_filter": true,
  "truncated": false,
  "model_version": "parsbert-v1",
  "inference_time_ms": 34.2
}
```

`detected` is sorted by confidence descending; empty/whitespace text returns
`200` with `detected: []`; text longer than 5000 chars is truncated and
returns `"truncated": true`.

Other endpoints:

```bash
curl http://localhost:8005/health
curl http://localhost:8005/model-info -H "X-Internal-API-Key: internal-secret-key-12345"
```

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `APP_NAME` | `AI NLP Service` | Service title |
| `DEBUG` | `false` | Debug logging level |
| `PORT` | `8000` | Port (container always listens on 8000) |
| `MODEL_PATH` | `./models/best_model.pt` | Checkpoint path (dict: `model_state_dict`, `f1`, `epoch`) |
| `EVIDENCE_PATH` | `./models/evidence_list_clean.json` | Evidence dictionary path |
| `MODEL_NAME` | `HooshvareLab/bert-fa-base-uncased` | Base ParsBERT model |
| `MODEL_VERSION` | `parsbert-v1` | Reported in responses |
| `THRESHOLD` | `0.3` | Default sigmoid threshold (per-request overridable) |
| `MAX_LEN` | `128` | Tokenizer max length |
| `DEVICE` | `""` | Empty = auto-detect (`cuda` if available else `cpu`); env override wins |
| `INTERNAL_API_KEY` | `internal-secret-key-12345` | Shared service-to-service key |
| `DEV_MODE` | `false` | Skip API key check — local testing only, never in production |

Append to the existing `services:` block in `./docker-compose.yml`:

```yaml
  ai-nlp-service:
    build:
      context: ./services/ai-nlp-service
      args:
        TORCH_VARIANT: cpu
    container_name: ai-nlp-service
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      APP_NAME: AI NLP Service

      MODEL_PATH: /app/models/best_model.pt
      EVIDENCE_PATH: /app/models/evidence_list_clean.json
      MODEL_NAME: HooshvareLab/bert-fa-base-uncased
      MODEL_VERSION: parsbert-v1
      THRESHOLD: "0.3"
      MAX_LEN: "128"
      INTERNAL_API_KEY: ${INTERNAL_API_KEY:-internal-secret-key-12345}
      DEV_MODE: "false"
    ports:
      - "8005:8000"   # local dev only — remove for production
    networks:
      - healthcare-network
```

No `depends_on` — this service has no external dependencies. Add it to the
existing `healthcare-network` (already exists).

## Patches to existing services

### 1. api-gateway — block `ai-nlp` at the gateway

`services/api-gateway/app/router/proxy.py`:

```diff
@@ ROUTE_PREFIX @@
 ROUTE_PREFIX = {
     "auth": "/auth",       # رفتار فعلی حفظ می‌شود
     "profile": "/profile", # profile-service: /profile/patient, /profile/doctor
     "intake": "",          # visit-intake-service: /visits, /doctor/visits
     "records": "/records", # medical-record-service: /records
 }

-INTERNAL_ONLY = {"triage"}
+INTERNAL_ONLY = {"triage", "ai-nlp"}
```

This prevents `ai-nlp-service` from ever being routed through the gateway.

### 2. visit-intake-service — plumb the service URL (future orchestration)

```diff
     MEDICAL_RECORD_SERVICE_URL: str = "http://localhost:8000"
+

```

`./docker-compose.yml` — add to the existing

No orchestration code is written yet — only the URL is plumbed.

## Decisions

1. **Routers resolve the singleton at request time** (`nlp_service_module.nlp_service`)
   instead of binding it at import. This is what makes the spec's test seam
   (`monkeypatch app.services.nlp_service.nlp_service`) work; a module-level
   `from ... import nlp_service` would freeze the reference and tests would hit
   the real (unloaded) service.
2. **Strict `>` threshold comparison** (per the spec's hierarchy pseudocode:
   `prob > threshold`). Consequence: `threshold=1.0` always returns `[]`.
3. **The spec's `threshold=0.9` test is inconsistent with its own fixture**
   (predictions `0.87 / 0.51` pass nothing through a strict `> 0.9` filter).
   The test overrides the fake's predictions with a top probability of `0.95`
   so the intent — "only the highest evidence survives" — is actually exercised.
4. **Truncated text is echoed back.** For inputs longer than 5000 chars the
   response `text` field contains the 5000-char prefix that was actually
   embedded (with `"truncated": true`), so callers can verify what was inferred.
5. **Availability check runs before the empty-text short-circuit.** Empty /
   whitespace-only text returns `200` with `detected: []` when the model is
   loaded, but still `503` when the service is degraded — an unavailable
   service should not pretend everything is fine.
6. **Pass-through metadata keeps its source keys.** `value_meaning` and
   `default_value` are already snake_case; the hyphenated `"possible-values"`
   is preserved verbatim in responses (validation accepts both spellings).
   None of the three is ever interpreted by this service.
7. **No `APIRouter(prefix=...)`.** Unlike sibling services, the contract here
   is root-level (`POST /extract`), so routers only carry tags.
8. **Model load runs via `run_in_threadpool` inside the lifespan** so the
   event loop is not blocked during startup; any load failure degrades to
   `503` (`/health`) instead of crashing the container — including the
   class-count sanity check
   (`classifier.weight.shape[0] != len(eid_list)`), which is logged as ERROR
   with both numbers.
9. **`training_f1` / `training_epoch` are coerced** to `float` / `int`
   (checkpoints often store tensors) and returned as `null` when missing or
   uncoercible, per the spec (`checkpoint.get("f1")`, `checkpoint.get("epoch")`).
10. **`hmac.compare_digest`** is used for the API key comparison instead of
    `==` (constant-time; same behaviour, slightly safer). The `DEV_MODE`
    skip matches the spec and the existing dependency signature exactly.
11. **The Docker build sanity-checks both artefacts.** The spec required a
    `test -f best_model.pt` guard; the same guard is added for
    `evidence_list_clean.json` since the service is equally dead without it.
12. **First boot needs HuggingFace access** (or a pre-seeded cache): the
    `EvidenceClassifier` is preserved verbatim, so `BertModel.from_pretrained`
    / `BertTokenizer.from_pretrained` fetch the base model on first run.
    Mount a cache volume (e.g. `HF_HOME=/cache/hf`) to avoid re-downloads or
    to run air-gapped.
13. **Single uvicorn worker (no `--workers N`).** The model is an in-process
    singleton; scale horizontally by replicas, not threads-within-container.
    Inference itself is dispatched to the thread pool
    (`starlette.concurrency.run_in_threadpool`) — never to a process pool.
14. **`requirements.txt` also installs test deps into the image** (single
    file per spec). Accepted bloat (~few MB); split into
    `requirements-dev.txt` if it bothers anyone.

"""Application configuration using Pydantic Settings."""
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings

# Relative artefact paths are resolved against the service directory, never
# against the process cwd (uvicorn may be started from anywhere).
SERVICE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def _resolve_path(value: str) -> str:
    path = Path(value)
    return str(path if path.is_absolute() else (SERVICE_ROOT / path).resolve())


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    """Application settings loaded from environment variables."""

    # App
    APP_NAME: str = "AI NLP Service"
    DEBUG: bool = False
    PORT: int = 8000

    # Model artefacts
    MODEL_PATH: str = "./models/best_model.pt"
    EVIDENCE_PATH: str = "./models/evidence_list_clean.json"
    MODEL_NAME: str = "HooshvareLab/bert-fa-base-uncased"
    MODEL_VERSION: str = "parsbert-v1"

    # Inference
    THRESHOLD: float = 0.3
    MAX_LEN: int = 128
    DEVICE: str = ""  # empty = auto-detect (cuda if available, else cpu)

    # Internal API Security (service-to-service calls only; no JWT here)
    INTERNAL_API_KEY: str = "internal-secret-key-12345"
    # DEV_MODE=true skips the internal API key check — local testing only!
    DEV_MODE: bool = False

    def model_post_init(self, __context) -> None:
        self.MODEL_PATH = _resolve_path(self.MODEL_PATH)
        self.EVIDENCE_PATH = _resolve_path(self.EVIDENCE_PATH)

    class Config:
        env_file = ".env"
        env_file_encoding = "utf-8"
        extra = "ignore"


@lru_cache()
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    """Return cached settings instance."""
    return Settings()


settings = get_settings()

"""Internal API key dependency for service-to-service calls."""
import hmac
import logging
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import Request

from app.config import settings
from app.exceptions import InternalAPIKeyError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def verify_internal_api_key(
    request: Request,
    x_internal_api_key: Optional[str] = None
) -> bool:
    """Verify service-to-service API key for internal endpoints.

    Internal endpoints should NOT be exposed through the API Gateway.
    They are only accessible directly between microservices.

    When DEV_MODE=true the check is skipped entirely (local curl testing
    only — never enable in production).
    """
    if settings.DEV_MODE:
        return True

    # Get from header if not passed directly
    if x_internal_api_key is None:
        x_internal_api_key = request.headers.get("X-Internal-API-Key")

    provided = (x_internal_api_key or "").encode("utf-8")
    expected = settings.INTERNAL_API_KEY.encode("utf-8")
    if not provided or not hmac.compare_digest(provided, expected):
        logger.warning(
            "Rejected request to %s: missing or invalid internal API key",
            request.url.path,
        )
        raise InternalAPIKeyError()

    return True

"""FastAPI application factory for AI NLP Service."""
import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from starlette.concurrency import run_in_threadpool

from app.config import settings
from app.routers.extract import router as extract_router
from app.routers.health import router as health_router
from app.services import nlp_service as nlp_service_module

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.DEBUG if settings.DEBUG else logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s | %(levelname)s | %(name)s | %(message)s",
)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    logger.info("%s starting up (dev_mode=%s)...", settings.APP_NAME, settings.DEV_MODE)
    # Loading torch weights is blocking work — keep it off the event loop.
    await run_in_threadpool(nlp_service_module.nlp_service.load)
    if nlp_service_module.nlp_service.loaded:
        logger.info("Model loaded on %s — service ready", nlp_service_module.nlp_service.device)
    else:
        logger.error(
            "Service started in degraded mode: model failed to load (%s) — /health returns 503",
            nlp_service_module.nlp_service.load_error,
        )
    yield
    logger.info("%s shutting down...", settings.APP_NAME)
    nlp_service_module.nlp_service.unload()


def create_application() -> FastAPI:
    app = FastAPI(
        title=settings.APP_NAME,
        description="""
        Healthcare AI - AI NLP Service

        Stateless inference microservice:
        - Persian free text in
        - Detected evidence codes with confidence scores out

        Internal-only. No database, no JWT, no orchestration — the
        visit-intake-service calls /extract, then triage, then persists
        the results in its own database.
        """,
        version="1.0.0",
        lifespan=lifespan,
        docs_url="/docs",
        redoc_url="/redoc",
        redirect_slashes=False,
    )

    app.include_router(health_router)
    app.include_router(extract_router)

    @app.exception_handler(Exception)
    async def global_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception):
        logger.exception("Unhandled error on %s %s", request.method, request.url.path)
        return JSONResponse(status_code=500, content={"detail": "Internal server error"})

    @app.get("/", tags=["Root"])
    async def root():
        return {
            "service": settings.APP_NAME,
            "version": "1.0.0",
            "model_loaded": nlp_service_module.nlp_service.loaded,
        }

    return app


app = create_application()

"""Inference endpoints: POST /extract and GET /model-info."""
import logging

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends

from app.config import settings
from app.dependencies.auth import verify_internal_api_key
from app.exceptions import ModelNotLoadedError
from app.schemas.nlp import ExtractRequest, ExtractResponse, ModelInfo
from app.services import nlp_service as nlp_service_module
from app.services.nlp_service import NLPService

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(tags=["Evidence Extraction"])

MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 5000


def _get_service() -> NLPService:
    # Resolve the singleton at request time so tests can monkeypatch
    # app.services.nlp_service.nlp_service with a fake.
    return nlp_service_module.nlp_service


def _ensure_loaded(service: NLPService) -> None:
    if not service.loaded:
        detail = "Model is not loaded"
        if service.load_error:
            detail = f"Model is not loaded: {service.load_error}"
        logger.error("Request rejected — %s", detail)
        raise ModelNotLoadedError(detail)


@router.post("/extract", response_model=ExtractResponse)
async def extract(
    payload: ExtractRequest,
    _api_key: bool = Depends(verify_internal_api_key),
) -> ExtractResponse:
    """Persian free text -> detected evidence codes with confidence scores."""
    service = _get_service()
    _ensure_loaded(service)

    text = payload.text or ""
    truncated = len(text) > MAX_TEXT_LENGTH
    if truncated:
        text = text[:MAX_TEXT_LENGTH]

    threshold = payload.threshold if payload.threshold is not None else settings.THRESHOLD

    if not text.strip():
        # Empty / whitespace-only input is a valid request with no evidence
        # (deliberately 200, not 400). No inference is run.
        logger.info("Empty or whitespace-only text received — returning empty result")
        return ExtractResponse(
            text=text,
            detected=[],
            threshold=threshold,
            apply_hierarchy_filter=payload.apply_hierarchy_filter,
            truncated=truncated,
            model_version=settings.MODEL_VERSION,
            inference_time_ms=0.0,
        )

    detected, elapsed_ms = await service.extract(
        text=text,
        threshold=threshold,
        top_k=payload.top_k,
        apply_hierarchy_filter=payload.apply_hierarchy_filter,
    )
    logger.info(
        "/extract: %d evidence(s) in %.1f ms (threshold=%s, top_k=%s, "
        "hierarchy_filter=%s, truncated=%s, chars=%d)",
        len(detected),
        elapsed_ms,
        threshold,
        payload.top_k,
        payload.apply_hierarchy_filter,
        truncated,
        len(text),
    )

    return ExtractResponse(
        text=text,
        detected=detected,
        threshold=threshold,
        apply_hierarchy_filter=payload.apply_hierarchy_filter,
        truncated=truncated,
        model_version=settings.MODEL_VERSION,
        inference_time_ms=round(elapsed_ms, 1),
    )


@router.get(
    "/model-info",
    response_model=ModelInfo,
    dependencies=[Depends(verify_internal_api_key)],
)
async def model_info() -> ModelInfo:
    """Checkpoint / evidence metadata for operators and callers."""
    service = _get_service()
    _ensure_loaded(service)

    return ModelInfo(
        model_name=settings.MODEL_NAME,
        checkpoint_path=settings.MODEL_PATH,
        evidence_path=settings.EVIDENCE_PATH,
        model_version=settings.MODEL_VERSION,
        evidence_count=service.evidence_count,
        threshold_default=settings.THRESHOLD,
        max_len=settings.MAX_LEN,
        device=service.device,
        training_f1=service.training_metadata.get("f1"),
        training_epoch=service.training_metadata.get("epoch"),
        loaded_at=service.loaded_at,
    )

"""Public health endpoint."""
import logging

from fastapi import APIRouter, Response

from app.schemas.nlp import HealthResponse
from app.services import nlp_service as nlp_service_module

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(tags=["Health"])


@router.get(
    "/health",
    response_model=HealthResponse,
    response_model_exclude_none=True,
    responses={503: {"model": HealthResponse}},
)
async def health(response: Response) -> HealthResponse:
    """200 when the model is loaded, 503 otherwise. No auth required."""
    service = nlp_service_module.nlp_service
    if service.loaded:
        return HealthResponse(
            status="healthy",
            model_loaded=True,
            device=service.device,
            evidence_count=service.evidence_count,
        )

    logger.warning("Health check failed: model not loaded (%s)", service.load_error)
    response.status_code = 503
    return HealthResponse(
        status="unhealthy",
        model_loaded=False,
        error=service.load_error or "Model is not loaded",
    )

"""Request/response contracts for the NLP inference API."""
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from pydantic import AliasChoices, BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


class ExtractRequest(BaseModel):
    """POST /extract request body."""

    text: str = Field(
        ...,
        description="Persian free text. Inputs longer than 5000 chars are truncated.",
    )
    threshold: Optional[float] = Field(
        default=None,
        gt=0.0,
        le=1.0,
        description="Detection threshold; defaults to settings.THRESHOLD when omitted.",
    )
    top_k: Optional[int] = Field(
        default=None,
        ge=1,
        description="Return only the K most confident evidences (after filtering).",
    )
    apply_hierarchy_filter: bool = Field(
        default=True,
        description="Drop child evidences whose parent evidence was not detected.",
    )


class DetectedEvidence(BaseModel):
    """One detected evidence with its probability and pass-through metadata.

    `value_meaning`, `possible-values` and `default_value` are passed through
    untouched for the follow-up questioning step — this service never
    interprets them.
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(populate_by_name=True)

    evidence_id: str
    name: str
    name_fa: Optional[str] = None
    question_en: Optional[str] = None
    question_fa: Optional[str] = None
    data_type: Optional[str] = None
    is_antecedent: Optional[bool] = None
    code_question: Optional[str] = None
    default_value: Optional[Any] = None
    value_meaning: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    # The source JSON key is "possible-values" (hyphenated); keep the original
    # key in responses for faithful pass-through.
    possible_values: Optional[List[Any]] = Field(
        default=None,
        validation_alias=AliasChoices("possible-values", "possible_values"),
        serialization_alias="possible-values",
    )
    confidence: float


class ExtractResponse(BaseModel):
    """POST /extract response body."""

    text: str
    detected: List[DetectedEvidence]
    threshold: float
    apply_hierarchy_filter: bool
    truncated: bool
    model_version: str
    inference_time_ms: float


class ModelInfo(BaseModel):
    """GET /model-info response body."""

    model_name: str
    checkpoint_path: str
    evidence_path: str
    model_version: str
    evidence_count: int
    threshold_default: float
    max_len: int
    device: str
    training_f1: Optional[float] = None
    training_epoch: Optional[int] = None
    loaded_at: Optional[str] = None


class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    """GET /health response body."""

    status: str
    model_loaded: bool
    device: Optional[str] = None
    evidence_count: Optional[int] = None
    error: Optional[str] = None

import torch.nn as nn
from transformers import BertModel

MODEL_NAME = "HooshvareLab/bert-fa-base-uncased"


class EvidenceClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_classes, model_name=MODEL_NAME, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.bert = BertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(self.bert.config.hidden_size, n_classes)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        outputs = self.bert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled = self.dropout(outputs.pooler_output)
        return self.classifier(pooled)

[36/214] ai-nlp-service/app/services/evidence_loader.py

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
"""Loader for evidence_list_clean.json.

The file is a JSON *object* keyed by evidence_id, e.g.:

    {
      "E_19_0001": {"name": "skin_lesions", "code_question": "E_19_0001", ...},
      "E_19_0002": {"name": "lesion_color", "code_question": "E_19_0001", ...},
      ...
    }

The classifier's output index maps to the lexically sorted evidence ids —
the model was trained with that ordering, so it must never change.
"""
import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def load_evidences(path: str) -> Tuple[List[str], Dict[str, dict]]:
    """Load the evidence dictionary.

    Returns:
        eid_list: lexically sorted evidence ids (stable model class order).
        eid_info: raw evidence definitions keyed by evidence_id, passed
                  through untouched (value_meaning / possible-values /
                  default_value are metadata for the questioning step).
    Raises:
        FileNotFoundError: when the file does not exist.
        ValueError: when the file is corrupt or not a non-empty JSON object.
    """
    evidence_path = Path(path)
    if not evidence_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Evidence file not found: {evidence_path}")

    with evidence_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        raw = json.load(f)

    if not isinstance(raw, dict) or not raw:
        raise ValueError(f"Evidence file must be a non-empty JSON object: {evidence_path}")

    eid_info: Dict[str, dict] = {str(key): value for key, value in raw.items()}
    eid_list: List[str] = sorted(eid_info.keys())  # stable class-index order

    logger.info("Loaded %d evidence definitions from %s", len(eid_list), evidence_path)
    return eid_list, eid_info

"""Stateless inference wrapper around the ParsBERT evidence classifier.

The model is loaded exactly once (lifespan startup) and shared by every
request. Torch inference never runs on the event loop — it is dispatched
to Starlette's thread pool via run_in_threadpool. There is deliberately
no ProcessPoolExecutor: the model is an in-process singleton.
"""
import logging
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

import numpy as np
import torch
from starlette.concurrency import run_in_threadpool
from transformers import BertTokenizer

from app.config import settings
from app.exceptions import ModelNotLoadedError
from app.schemas.nlp import DetectedEvidence
from app.services.classifier import EvidenceClassifier
from app.services.evidence_loader import load_evidences

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def postprocess_probabilities(
    probs: np.ndarray,
    eid_list: List[str],
    eid_info: Dict[str, dict],
    threshold: float,
    top_k: Optional[int],
    apply_hierarchy_filter: bool,
) -> List[DetectedEvidence]:
    """Shared multi-label post-processing (also reused by the test fake).

    1. keep evidences with probability strictly greater than `threshold`,
    2. sort by confidence descending,
    3. optional hierarchy filter: a child evidence (code_question pointing at
       another evidence) is only kept when its parent is also detected —
       root evidences (code_question == own id) are always kept,
    4. optional top-k cut, applied after the filter.
    """
    if len(probs) != len(eid_list):
        raise ValueError(
            f"Probability vector length {len(probs)} != evidence count {len(eid_list)}"
        )

    scored: List[Tuple[str, float]] = [
        (eid, float(probs[idx])) for idx, eid in enumerate(eid_list)
    ]
    detected = [(eid, prob) for eid, prob in scored if prob > threshold]
    detected.sort(key=lambda item: item[1], reverse=True)

    detected_ids = {eid for eid, _ in detected}

    results: List[DetectedEvidence] = []
    dropped: List[str] = []
    for eid, prob in detected:
        info = eid_info.get(eid, {})
        parent = info.get("code_question") or eid  # missing -> treat as root
        if apply_hierarchy_filter and parent != eid and parent not in detected_ids:
            dropped.append(eid)
            continue
        results.append(_build_detected_evidence(eid, prob, info))

    if dropped:
        logger.warning(
            "Hierarchy filter dropped %d child evidence(s) with no detected parent: %s",
            len(dropped),
            ", ".join(dropped),
        )

    if top_k is not None:
        results = results[:top_k]

    return results


def _build_detected_evidence(eid: str, prob: float, info: Dict[str, Any]) -> DetectedEvidence:
    """Map a raw evidence definition to the response schema (pass-through)."""
    return DetectedEvidence(
        evidence_id=eid,
        name=info.get("name", eid),
        name_fa=info.get("name_fa"),
        question_en=info.get("question_en"),
        question_fa=info.get("question_fa"),
        data_type=info.get("data_type"),
        is_antecedent=info.get("is_antecedent"),
        code_question=info.get("code_question"),
        default_value=info.get("default_value"),
        value_meaning=info.get("value_meaning"),
        possible_values=info.get("possible-values"),
        confidence=round(prob, 4),
    )


class NLPService:
    """Singleton wrapper around the trained EvidenceClassifier."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.model: Optional[EvidenceClassifier] = None
        self.tokenizer: Optional[BertTokenizer] = None
        self.eid_list: List[str] = []
        self.eid_info: Dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.device: str = "cpu"
        self.loaded_at: Optional[str] = None
        self.loaded: bool = False
        self.load_error: Optional[str] = None
        self.training_metadata: Dict[str, Any] = {}

    @property
    def evidence_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.eid_list)

    def load(self) -> None:
        """Load evidences, tokenizer and checkpoint. Never raises.

        Any failure leaves the service alive in a degraded state:
        /health reports 503 and /extract + /model-info raise
        ModelNotLoadedError (503).
        """
        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            # Env override DEVICE takes priority; otherwise auto-detect.
            if settings.DEVICE:
                device = settings.DEVICE
            else:
                device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
            self.device = str(device)
            logger.info("Using device: %s", self.device)

            self.eid_list, self.eid_info = load_evidences(settings.EVIDENCE_PATH)

            logger.info("Loading tokenizer: %s", settings.MODEL_NAME)
            self.tokenizer = BertTokenizer.from_pretrained(settings.MODEL_NAME)

            logger.info("Loading checkpoint: %s", settings.MODEL_PATH)
            checkpoint = torch.load(
                settings.MODEL_PATH,
                map_location=self.device,
                weights_only=False,  # required for PyTorch 2.6+
            )
            if not isinstance(checkpoint, dict) or "model_state_dict" not in checkpoint:
                raise ValueError("Checkpoint must be a dict containing 'model_state_dict'")

            state_dict = checkpoint["model_state_dict"]
            n_classes = int(state_dict["classifier.weight"].shape[0])
            if n_classes != len(self.eid_list):
                # The most common deployment bug: checkpoint trained against a
                # different evidence list. Stay alive, report unhealthy.
                logger.error(
                    "Class-count mismatch: checkpoint has %d output classes but "
                    "evidence list has %d entries — refusing to load",
                    n_classes,
                    len(self.eid_list),
                )
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Checkpoint class count ({n_classes}) != evidence count ({len(self.eid_list)})"
                )

            model = EvidenceClassifier(n_classes=n_classes, model_name=settings.MODEL_NAME)
            model.load_state_dict(state_dict)
            model.to(self.device)
            model.eval()  # inference only — disable dropout for determinism
            self.model = model

            self.training_metadata = {
                "f1": self._as_float(checkpoint.get("f1"), "f1"),
                "epoch": self._as_int(checkpoint.get("epoch"), "epoch"),
            }

            self.loaded_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
            self.loaded = True
            self.load_error = None
            logger.info(
                "Model '%s' loaded on %s in %.1f ms (%d evidences, training_f1=%s, training_epoch=%s)",
                settings.MODEL_VERSION,
                self.device,
                (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000,
                len(self.eid_list),
                self.training_metadata["f1"],
                self.training_metadata["epoch"],
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.loaded = False
            self.load_error = str(exc) or exc.__class__.__name__
            self.model = None
            self.tokenizer = None
            logger.error("Model failed to load: %s", self.load_error, exc_info=True)

    def unload(self) -> None:
        """Release model resources on shutdown."""
        self.loaded = False
        self.model = None
        self.tokenizer = None
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
        logger.info("Model resources released")

    async def extract(
        self,
        text: str,
        threshold: float,
        top_k: Optional[int] = None,
        apply_hierarchy_filter: bool = True,
    ) -> Tuple[List[DetectedEvidence], float]:
        """Run inference in the thread pool; returns (detected, elapsed_ms)."""
        return await run_in_threadpool(
            self._infer_sync, text, threshold, top_k, apply_hierarchy_filter
        )

    def _infer_sync(
        self,
        text: str,
        threshold: float,
        top_k: Optional[int],
        apply_hierarchy_filter: bool,
    ) -> Tuple[List[DetectedEvidence], float]:
        if not self.loaded or self.model is None or self.tokenizer is None:
            raise ModelNotLoadedError()

        started = time.perf_counter()

        encoding = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            add_special_tokens=True,
            max_length=settings.MAX_LEN,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = self.model(
                encoding["input_ids"].to(self.device),
                encoding["attention_mask"].to(self.device),
            )
            probs = torch.sigmoid(outputs).cpu().numpy()[0]  # multi-label

        detected = postprocess_probabilities(
            probs=probs,
            eid_list=self.eid_list,
            eid_info=self.eid_info,
            threshold=threshold,
            top_k=top_k,
            apply_hierarchy_filter=apply_hierarchy_filter,
        )

        elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
        logger.info(
            "Inference finished in %.1f ms: %d evidence(s) above threshold %.2f",
            elapsed_ms,
            len(detected),
            threshold,
        )
        return detected, elapsed_ms

    @staticmethod
    def _as_float(value: Any, label: str) -> Optional[float]:
        if value is None:
            return None
        try:
            return float(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            logger.warning("Could not coerce checkpoint %s=%r to float", label, value)
            return None

    @staticmethod
    def _as_int(value: Any, label: str) -> Optional[int]:
        if value is None:
            return None
        try:
            return int(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            logger.warning("Could not coerce checkpoint %s=%r to int", label, value)
            return None


# Module-level singleton — import this, never instantiate elsewhere.
nlp_service = NLPService()

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Model artefacts

Place the trained artefacts here **before** `docker build`:

| File | Description | Size |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `best_model.pt` | PyTorch checkpoint: `{"model_state_dict": ..., "f1": ..., "epoch": ...}` | ~600 MB |
| `evidence_list_clean.json` | Evidence dictionary — JSON **object** keyed by evidence_id | small |

The Docker build fails on purpose (`test -f` sanity checks in the Dockerfile)
when either file is missing, so a broken image can never be produced.

The startup sanity check also compares
`checkpoint["model_state_dict"]["classifier.weight"].shape[0]` with the number
of keys in `evidence_list_clean.json`; on mismatch the service stays alive but
reports `503` on `/health` instead of crashing.

For local runs without Docker you can point `MODEL_PATH` / `EVIDENCE_PATH`
somewhere else via `.env`.

"""Shared fixtures for ai-nlp-service tests.

The real NLPService is replaced by FakeNLPService so tests never touch
torch, the checkpoint or the HuggingFace hub. The fake reuses the real
post-processing logic (threshold -> sort -> hierarchy filter -> top_k)
via postprocess_probabilities(), only the torch part is faked.

from app.services import nlp_service as nlp_service_module  # noqa: E402

TEST_INTERNAL_API_KEY = "internal-secret-key-12345"

AUTH_HEADERS = {"X-Internal-API-Key": TEST_INTERNAL_API_KEY}

# Fake evidence_list (same shape as evidence_list_clean.json: dict keyed by
# evidence_id). E_19_0001 is a root evidence (code_question == own id) and

FAKE_EVIDENCE_LIST: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {

class FakeNLPService:
    """Test double mirroring NLPService's public interface, without torch."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        predictions: Optional[List[Tuple[str, float]]] = None,
        loaded: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        self.loaded = loaded
        self.load_error = None if loaded else "checkpoint not found (fake)"
        self.device = "cpu"
        self.eid_list: List[str] = sorted(FAKE_EVIDENCE_LIST.keys())
        self.eid_info: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = FAKE_EVIDENCE_LIST
        self.loaded_at = "2026-01-15T10:30:00Z"
        self.training_metadata: Dict[str, Any] = {"f1": 0.84, "epoch": 3}
        # Default predictions from the spec's happy-path fixture.
        self.predictions = predictions if predictions is not None else [
            ("E_19_0001", 0.87),
            ("E_19_0002", 0.51),
        ]

    @property
    def evidence_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.eid_list)

    async def extract(
        self,
        text: str,
        threshold: float,
        top_k: Optional[int] = None,
        apply_hierarchy_filter: bool = True,
    ) -> Tuple[List[DetectedEvidence], float]:
        probs = np.zeros(len(self.eid_list), dtype=float)
        for eid, prob in self.predictions:
            probs[self.eid_list.index(eid)] = prob

        detected = postprocess_probabilities(
            probs=probs,
            eid_list=self.eid_list,
            eid_info=self.eid_info,
            threshold=threshold,
            top_k=top_k,
            apply_hierarchy_filter=apply_hierarchy_filter,
        )
        return detected, 12.3


@pytest.fixture
def fake_nlp_service() -> FakeNLPService:
    return FakeNLPService()

) -> AsyncClient:

    async with AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as async_client:
        yield async_client

import pytest

from app.config import settings
from app.services import nlp_service as nlp_service_module

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_extract_happy_path(client):
    resp = await client.post(
        "/extract",
        headers=AUTH_HEADERS,
        json={"text": "سلام پوستم قرمز شده. سرم درد میکنه تب هم دارم"},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()

    # Sorted by confidence desc: 0.87 before 0.51.
    assert [d["evidence_id"] for d in body["detected"]] == ["E_19_0001", "E_19_0002"]
    assert body["detected"][0]["confidence"] == 0.87
    assert body["detected"][0]["name"] == "skin_lesions"
    assert body["detected"][0]["name_fa"] == "ضایعات پوستی"
    assert body["detected"][0]["data_type"] == "B"
    assert body["detected"][0]["code_question"] == "E_19_0001"

    # Response envelope.
    assert body["threshold"] == 0.3
    assert body["apply_hierarchy_filter"] is True
    assert body["truncated"] is False
    assert body["model_version"] == settings.MODEL_VERSION
    assert isinstance(body["inference_time_ms"], float)

"""Application configuration using Pydantic Settings.

Updated: now points at TWO downstream AI services:
  - ai-nlp-service       (ParsBERT — evidence extraction)
  - ai-diagnosis-service (LogisticRegression — disease prediction)

ai-triage-service is INTERNAL ONLY:
  - called by other services (visit-intake-service, ...) with
    X-Internal-API-Key, never directly by the frontend;
  - it calls downstream AI model services with the same internal key.
"""
from functools import lru_cache

from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    """Settings loaded from environment variables."""

    # App
    APP_NAME: str = "AI Triage Service"
    DEBUG: bool = False
    PORT: int = 8000

    # Downstream AI model services (this service is the caller)
    AI_NLP_SERVICE_URL: str = "http://ai-nlp-service:8000"
    AI_NLP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: float = 30.0

    # NEW — ai-diagnosis-service (disease prediction from evidence_ids)
    AI_DIAGNOSIS_SERVICE_URL: str = "http://ai-diagnosis-service:8000"
    AI_DIAGNOSIS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: float = 30.0
    AI_DIAGNOSIS_DEFAULT_TOP_K: int = 10

    # Upstream caller services (for the full-orchestration endpoints)
    VISIT_INTAKE_SERVICE_URL: str = "http://visit-intake-service:8000"
    VISIT_INTAKE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: float = 15.0

    # Internal API key — shared across all internal services.
    # Used both to verify incoming calls and to authenticate outgoing calls.
    INTERNAL_API_KEY: str = "internal-secret-key-12345"

    class Config:
        env_file = ".env"
        env_file_encoding = "utf-8"
        extra = "ignore"


@lru_cache()
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    """Return cached settings instance."""
    return Settings()


settings = get_settings()

[51/214] ai-triage-service/app/dependencies/auth.py

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
"""Internal API key dependency — the ONLY auth on this service.

ai-triage-service is internal-only. It is NEVER exposed through the API
Gateway and NEVER called directly by the frontend. Every incoming request
must carry X-Internal-API-Key matching the shared INTERNAL_API_KEY.

Outgoing calls (to ai-nlp-service, visit-intake-service, ...) attach the
same key in their X-Internal-API-Key header.
"""
import hmac
import logging
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import Request

from app.config import settings
from app.exceptions import InternalAPIKeyError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def verify_internal_api_key(
    request: Request,
    x_internal_api_key: Optional[str] = None,
) -> bool:
    """Verify the service-to-service API key.

    The check is constant-time (hmac.compare_digest) to avoid timing attacks.
    """
    if x_internal_api_key is None:
        x_internal_api_key = request.headers.get("X-Internal-API-Key")

    provided = (x_internal_api_key or "").encode("utf-8")
    expected = settings.INTERNAL_API_KEY.encode("utf-8")

    if not provided or not hmac.compare_digest(provided, expected):
        logger.warning(
            "Rejected request to %s %s: missing or invalid internal API key",
            request.method,
            request.url.path,
        )
        raise InternalAPIKeyError()

    return True

"""Custom exceptions for the AI Triage service."""
from fastapi import HTTPException, status


class InternalAPIKeyError(HTTPException):
    """Missing or invalid X-Internal-API-Key on an internal endpoint."""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Invalid or missing internal API key",
        )


class NLPServiceUnavailableError(HTTPException):
    """ai-nlp-service is unreachable or returned a non-200 response."""

    def __init__(self, detail: str = "ai-nlp-service is unavailable"):
        super().__init__(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail=detail,
        )


class DiagnosisServiceUnavailableError(HTTPException):
    """ai-diagnosis-service is unreachable or returned a non-200 response."""

    def __init__(self, detail: str = "ai-diagnosis-service is unavailable"):
        super().__init__(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail=detail,
        )


class VisitServiceUnavailableError(HTTPException):
    """visit-intake-service is unreachable when the orchestration flow needs it."""

    def __init__(self, detail: str = "visit-intake-service is unavailable"):
        super().__init__(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail=detail,
        )


class TriageError(HTTPException):
    """Generic triage failure (e.g. empty visit, malformed upstream payload)."""

    def __init__(self, detail: str = "Triage failed"):
        super().__init__(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail=detail,
        )


class DiagnosisError(HTTPException):
    """Generic diagnosis failure (e.g. no evidences available, empty visit)."""

    def __init__(self, detail: str = "Diagnosis failed"):
        super().__init__(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail=detail,
        )

"""FastAPI application factory for AI Triage Service.

This service is INTERNAL ONLY. It is not exposed through the API Gateway
and is never called directly by the frontend. Other backend services
(visit-intake-service, ...) call it with X-Internal-API-Key.

Architecture:
    frontend → visit-intake-service → ai-triage-service → ai-nlp-service
                                       (this service)      (ParsBERT)
                                                            ↘
                                                              ai-diagnosis-service
                                                              (LogisticRegression)
"""
import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from app.config import settings
from app.routers import health, triage, diagnosis

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.DEBUG if settings.DEBUG else logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s | %(levelname)s | %(name)s | %(message)s",
)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    logger.info("%s starting up...", settings.APP_NAME)
    logger.info("  downstream: ai-nlp-service       = %s", settings.AI_NLP_SERVICE_URL)
    logger.info("  downstream: ai-diagnosis-service  = %s", settings.AI_DIAGNOSIS_SERVICE_URL)
    logger.info("  upstream:   visit-intake-service  = %s", settings.VISIT_INTAKE_SERVICE_URL)
    yield
    logger.info("%s shutting down...", settings.APP_NAME)


def create_application() -> FastAPI:
    app = FastAPI(
        title=settings.APP_NAME,
        description="""
        Healthcare AI - AI Triage Service (INTERNAL)

        Orchestrator between caller services (visit-intake-service, ...) and
        AI model services:
          - ai-nlp-service       (ParsBERT — evidence extraction)
          - ai-diagnosis-service (LogisticRegression — disease prediction)

        NOT exposed through the API Gateway. Every endpoint except /health
        requires X-Internal-API-Key.

        Endpoints:
          POST /extract-evidences         — text → evidences + priority
          POST /visits/{id}/triage        — full visit triage orchestration
          POST /diagnose                  — evidences → disease predictions (passthrough)
          POST /visits/{id}/diagnose      — full visit diagnosis orchestration
          GET  /model-info                — passthrough to ai-nlp-service
          GET  /health                    — service + downstream health
        """,
        version="1.1.0",
        lifespan=lifespan,
        docs_url="/docs",
        redoc_url="/redoc",
        redirect_slashes=False,
    )

    # CORS: open within the docker network. The Gateway handles public CORS.
    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=["*"],
        allow_credentials=True,
        allow_methods=["*"],
        allow_headers=["*"],
    )

    app.include_router(health.router)
    app.include_router(triage.router)
    app.include_router(diagnosis.router)   # ← NEW diagnosis endpoints

    @app.exception_handler(Exception)
    async def global_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception):
        logger.exception("Unhandled error on %s %s", request.method, request.url.path)
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=500,
            content={"detail": "Internal server error"},
        )

    @app.get("/", tags=["Root"])
    async def root():
        return {
            "service": settings.APP_NAME,
            "version": "1.1.0",
            "type": "internal",
            "docs": "/docs",
        }

    return app


app = create_application()
